subtitle: Your personal agent
slogan: A little more room for life.
promotionalText: Talk things through, hand off a task, and keep the thoughts you want to remember. Impo brings your conversations, Echo recordings, and daily Brief together.
description:
A little more room for life.

Impo is your personal agent for the thoughts, tasks, and everyday details you choose to share. Talk things through, capture a thought with Echo, or hand off a task and come back when it is ready.

TALK IT THROUGH
Keep an ongoing conversation with your personal agent. Type a message or hold the input to speak. Read clear answers with lists, tables, code, and formulas, then select and copy the parts you need.

GIVE A TASK ITS OWN SPACE
Start an independent task for research, planning, or a first draft. Each task has its own conversation, so you can ask follow-up questions and find the result later. Open, share, and save files delivered with a reply. Server-side work continues when you leave the app. Schedule one-time or recurring tasks, then review each run in its own conversation.

KEEP THE THOUGHT WITH ECHO
Start Echo when you want to capture spoken thoughts. It turns recorded speech into a transcript timeline you can revisit and delete. Recording starts only when you choose, with optional place context.

A BRIEF THAT STARTS WITH YOU
Get personal Brief cards based on your recent conversations, completed tasks, and Echo transcripts. Choose your briefing times and look back through earlier editions.

LESS REPEATING, MORE REMEMBERING
Impo saves useful context from your conversations and the Echo speech you confirm as yours, then brings relevant memories into Chat. Browse those memories and forget the ones you no longer want kept.

CONNECT ON YOUR TERMS
Choose whether to connect supported services or grant access to Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Health. Connections are optional. Control Chat, Task, and Brief notifications separately in Settings.

Impo is open source: https://github.com/impoai/impo

Create an account with Apple or Google, or sign in to an existing account with email and password. An internet connection is required. AI features process information through Impo and its service providers; review the in-app notices and Privacy Policy before sharing. AI answers can be inaccurate. Health features are informational, not medical advice.

Privacy: https://impo.ai/privacy/
Support: https://impo.ai/support/
reviewNotes:
REVIEW ACCOUNT — IMPO 1.0 (60)
Use the dedicated username and password in the Sign-in Information fields.
1. Open Impo and tap Let's begin.
2. Tap Sign in with email, enter the supplied email and password, and tap Sign in.
3. This dedicated account does not require an email code, phone code, invitation, subscription or purchase. It uses the same production service and features as other accounts.
4. If first-time setup appears, read the AI Data Processing Notice and tap I Agree. Tap Skip for now for optional connections, continue, name your personal agent and choose an appearance. Returning accounts restore their saved profile.
5. If Choose a city appears, tap Not now to continue without location access.
The account is reserved for Apple review and contains only synthetic test content. No personal email, calendar, health or external-service accounts are connected.

FEATURE WALKTHROUGH
- Chat: send "Help me plan a quiet weekend". Hold the empty input to record a voice message; release to transcribe and send, or slide up to cancel.
- Tasks: Tasks > + > Add a Task. Enter a planning or research request. Reopen the task for its result or a follow-up. Ask for a short PDF and open its file card to preview, share or save it.
- Scheduled tasks: Tasks > Scheduled. Create a one-time, daily or weekly plan; each occurrence has its own result.
- Echo: tap Echo, read the recording disclosure and start recording. Stop explicitly. Open the completed recording to browse its transcript, identify your own speech, exclude passages or delete it. Use your own speech or obtain permission to record others.
- Memories: Echo/Memory > About you. Browse or forget saved context. Brief and Memories are generated by background jobs; a new account can initially be empty.
- Brief: browse editions and configure briefing times and preferences. Refreshing does not immediately generate a new edition.
- Connections: Chat > Settings > Connections. All connections and native permissions are optional. Calendar, Contacts and Health are read-only; Reminders can be created on request.
- Notifications: Chat > Settings > Notifications. Categories have separate switches. Foreground banners are suppressed.
- Account deletion: Chat > Settings > Delete account > Continue. Type DELETE and confirm to delete the signed-in account and its data.

BACKGROUND AUDIO AND LOCATION
Echo records only after the user starts it and grants microphone permission. Recording can continue while the screen is locked; a Live Activity shows status and Stop. Optional recording-time location accompanies Echo only while recording. Brief city refresh occurs in the foreground. Push notifications never start microphone recording.

DATA PROCESSING
Clerk handles authentication; Rebyte runs the personal agent; Google Gemini transcribes speech and creates memory embeddings; Composio supports optional external connections. The app presents AI processing disclosure and consent before onboarding. Privacy: https://impo.ai/privacy/

If access fails or the review account has been deleted during testing, contact the review contact listed in App Store Connect.
